selection_status: Candidates, pending user screening; not mastery evidence
method: Read all 597 subtitle cues in three consecutive batches of no more than 240 cues. Inspect outer communication frames and inner collocations/idioms; exclude credit and background-TV dialogue, known basic formulae and isolated unfamiliar words. Deduplicate within episode and against existing E01–E04 selections, retaining only distinct construction or sense where repeated. Quotes join consecutive original cues with spaces, preserve wording, false starts and presentation tags. Subtitle-only extraction, not audio-verified.

lexical_checks.note: Verified search far and wide; distinct from beat around the bush.
Verified take a flyer = take a risk on an uncertain outcome; visiting a possible witness is the contextual application.
Verified become intoxicated or go on a drinking spree.
Verified US informal sense: pass time idly or wander from place to place; contextual staying in town.
Verified verb phrase: seek sexual activity indiscriminately; suspicion of marital infidelity is contextual.

items.meaning: 这可是你要求的（也可警告：后果自负）

items.meaning: 别对我来这一套……（复述对方刚说的话来制止）

items.chunk: I'm sorry it took me so long.

items.meaning: 走出某事，继续生活

items.meaning: 具体哪里不同？（追问对方模糊的描述）

items.meaning: 出了什么事／有情况（常暗示不对劲）

items.meaning: 闭口不谈、突然不肯说话

items.meaning: 就我记得的而言……（限定记忆可靠范围）

items.meaning: 听清、辨认出某内容（此处没听清谈话）

items.meaning: 质问、当面指出某人的行为／问题
items.quote: But the next morning, I called him out... "What the hell was that about? What's going on?" And he wouldn't talk to me.

items.meaning: 亲密无间、关系非常好（不指真是盗贼）

items.meaning: 这让我觉得／推测……（指出推断依据）

items.meaning: 与某人推心置腹的谈话

items.meaning: 一遍又一遍、反复

items.meaning: 要是当时我……，就可能本来可以……（回想未实现的可能）
items.quote: I know what you're doing... replaying it over and over, thinking, "if I'd noticed this or changed that", maybe I could have done something."

items.meaning: 你不会以为我没……过吧？（双重否定反驳对方的猜想）

items.meaning: 自责、反复责怪自己

items.chunk: That's all there is to it.

items.meaning: 看来也就这样了／只能到此为止（接受终局）

items.meaning: 时间不早了（委婉结束谈话）

items.meaning: 顺道过来、短暂拜访

items.quote: Well, if you want me to drop by and keep an eye on her, I... I want to help.

items.chunk: You're gonna want to do sth.

items.meaning: 放轻松、别劳累（此处让伤口恢复）
items.quote: You're gonna want to take it easy. Keep it clean. Keep it dry. Let it heal.

items.meaning: 额外附送／搭上某物

items.meaning: 由店家免费招待／赠送
items.quote: Tell you what... take a couple on the house. In case you change your mind.

items.meaning: 以防／万一某人……（预先准备）
items.quote: In case you change your mind.

items.meaning: 路过、暂时经过某地

items.meaning: 留下来待一阵、暂不离开
items.quote: Passing through or sticking around?

items.meaning: 没什么大不了的（俚语，原例省略主语）
items.quote: It's just a couple of questions. Uh, ain't nothing but a thing.

items.meaning: 我原以为你会更……（表达失望／施压）

items.meaning: 你能告诉我……吗？（口语追问，可带责问）

items.meaning: 接下来这样办（宣布流程／安排）

items.chunk: Why, pray tell, would I do that?
items.meaning: 请问，我凭什么那么做？（故作礼貌的反问）

items.meaning: 我怀疑是否……／恐怕不……（表达不相信）

items.meaning: 我可真傻啊（此处自我挖苦以讽刺对方）

items.meaning: 协助、教唆（通常指违法；较正式）

items.chunk: dot your i's and cross your t's

items.quote: Now, those two jokers out in the hallway... I'm gonna make sure they dot their I's and cross their t's... everything square and above board.

items.quote: I'm gonna make sure they dot their I's and cross their t's... everything square and above board.

items.meaning: 绝不可能／我不会答应（断然拒绝）

items.meaning: 信不信由你（引出可能让人意外的事实）
items.quote: He's actually... believe it or not... somewhat taciturn.

items.meaning: 想必你已经看出来／明白了……

items.meaning: 失去控制、局面无法收拾

items.meaning: 逃出来、成功离开（此处没有活着逃出）

items.meaning: 四处搜寻、竭力寻找（别与 beat around the bush 绕弯子混淆）

items.meaning: 查无结果、空手而归（寻找线索语境）
items.quote: Anyways, we kept beating the bushes, kept coming up dry until three months ago.

items.meaning: 卷入某种不正当／麻烦事

items.meaning: 孤注一掷、成功希望渺茫的最后一招（美式比喻）

items.meaning: 确凿证据（hard 不是物理硬度）
items.quote: I mean, if we had any hard evidence or leads, we wouldn't be out here.

items.meaning: 当时不可能是……（对过去作否定推断）

items.chunk: You didn't think to do sth.?
items.meaning: 你没想到要……吗？（事后质问遗漏的行动）

items.meaning: 得到回报、取得预期成果
items.quote: I'm sorry you guys took a flier on me. I wish it'd have paid off.

items.chunk: How could you possibly think that?

items.meaning: 把某物藏好、存放在不显眼处

items.meaning: 天知道哪里／不知道从哪里（强调来源不明）

items.chunk: All I want is for sb. to do sth.
items.meaning: 我只要某人……（集中说明诉求，for 引出动作的人）

items.meaning: 尽情哭出来、把悲痛哭出来

items.meaning: 好久不见／有一阵子了（口语，非一分钟）
items.quote: Good to see you, too. It's been a minute.

items.meaning: 开车送某人一程

items.meaning: 在我看来、按我的标准
items.quote: That's a big minus in my book.

items.quote: Shit, yeah, he did... put it away like they were fixing to bring back prohibition.

items.meaning: 把压在心里的话／烦恼说出来

items.meaning: 预见某事会发生、料到后果

items.meaning: 帮某人一个忙；原例为犯罪者的自我开脱
items.quote: We're doing him a favor.

items.chunk: That's what I would have done if I were you.
items.meaning: 换作是你，我也会那样做（回评对方过去的选择）
items.quote: Smart. That's what I would have done if I were you.

items.meaning: 睁一只眼闭一只眼、放任不管

items.meaning: 对不当行为装作没看见
items.quote: You let some things slide and you look the other way. You bust a drug dealer that has more cash than you'll ever earn in a lifetime. Some of it doesn't make it back into evidence... So what?

items.meaning: 向当局检举某人／交出某人

items.meaning: 为了合群、相安无事而随大流（通常带妥协意味）

items.meaning: 让某人分一份利益／加入赚钱的勾当

items.meaning: 转而反对／背叛某人（此处举报）
items.quote: do the right thing, shut 'em down. Oh, my God. And you let him? That's why he got killed... 'cause he was gonna turn on those guys?

items.meaning: 被关进监狱

items.meaning: 把某人送进监狱（与前文喝酒的 put it away 区分）
items.quote: Prison... getting locked up with everybody you put away.

items.meaning: 说有道理的话；原例是劝其采取自己认为“现实”的做法
items.quote: I talked sense. No one was getting hurt. But if you go to the I.A., if you even look like you're going...

items.quote: I told him I did it, too, that I was like Hoffman, getting by, and that's what you heard that night...

items.meaning: 劝某人冷静、打消激烈想法（不同于 E02 把刑罚谈低）

items.meaning: 极不情愿、激烈反抗（此处从抵抗到屈服）
items.quote: me talking him down, him kicking and screaming until the fight went out of him.

items.meaning: 过度崇拜、把某人理想化
items.quote: He put me up on a pedestal... And I had to show him, that I was down in the gutter with the rest of them. Broke my boy.

items.meaning: 处于道德低下／堕落的境地（原例自责）
items.quote: He put me up on a pedestal... And I had to show him, that I was down in the gutter with the rest of them. Broke my boy.

items.meaning: 使／说服某人做某事（原例强烈自责）
items.quote: I got Matty to take the money. And they killed him two days later.

items.chunk: sb. would never do sth., not even to do sth.
items.meaning: 某人绝不会……，即便为了……也不会（强调原则／拒绝）

items.meaning: 问题在于……（把谈话收束到关键）

items.meaning: 你能接受／承受这件事吗？（此处指能否接受真相的道德后果）
items.quote: You know what happened. The question is... can you live with it?
